# The Day of Maurício Issei — Interactive Narrative in Pixel Art

> Markdown (GEO/AEO) version of <https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/life>. Author: **Maurício Yokoyama Issei** · en-BR · Published: 2026-01-20 · Updated: 2026-06-21.

## Experience

Interactive narrative in pixel art, covered with arrow keys: the life trajectory and career of Maurício Issei from 1982 to today, scene the scene — technology, family and evolution. The content is visual and generated in the browser. The same story, in text, is in [Evolutionary Terminal](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/terminal-evolutivo.md); there is also [3D version](https://mauricio.issei.com.br/en/life3d).
